summary: Primary RenderStream control and sync node for Disguise integration. It receives control channels, drives frame sync, and can expose schema-defined parameters.
key_concepts: RenderStream In CHOP is the primary TouchDesigner node for controlling and configuring a Disguise RenderStream connection.
The node is Pro-only and acts as the sync point for the start of RenderStream frame rendering.
RenderStream workflows usually turn off TouchDesigner's Real-Time flag so this CHOP, rather than normal timeline advancement, drives frames.
The node brings in control channels and can build sequencable Disguise parameters from a schema DAT.
Schema DAT rows require group, label, name, and type columns; default, min, max, and step are optional.
Schema float data arrives as CHOP channels, image data is handled through RenderStream In TOP, and text data is read through an Info DAT.

key_params.name: schemadat
key_params.note: Schema table for controllable parameters in Disguise

key_params.name: exporttable

common_gotchas: Real-Time is usually turned off so the RenderStream CHOP drives frame advancement.
The schema DAT needs the required group, label, name, and type columns.
Only float schema data appears as CHOP channels; image and text schema data require RenderStream In TOP or Info DAT.
Timeout controls how long the node stalls waiting for sync before giving up, so it directly affects frame-wait behavior.
Stream Index must match the intended RenderStream stream when multiple streams are available.
